product_overview: Uponco is a public appointment booking and scheduling product for service businesses. Customers can choose a service, specialist, location, date, and time, then confirm without creating an account.
core_goals: Let customers book appointments through a public shareable booking page without logging in
Help customers choose an appropriate service, specialist, and location for their appointment
Let customers select an available date and time slot and confirm the booking
Allow customers to cancel a booking through a signed cancellation link
Support deep links that preselect a service, specialist, or location

features.name: Public booking page with company services
features.description: Customers can open the public booking wizard and browse the company's active services, including their prices, durations, and descriptions.
user_flows: Navigate to /appointments/zz-schedule-preview -> See the company header and booking heading -> Expand the service section -> Read the available services with prices and durations -> Select a service -> See the chosen service collapse into the booking summary

features.name: Choose specialist
features.description: Customers can narrow the booking by selecting a specialist who can perform the chosen service, and view specialist details if needed.
user_flows: Navigate to /appointments/zz-schedule-preview -> Select a service -> Open the specialist section -> Review the specialists available for that service -> Open a specialist profile to read about them -> Close the profile -> Select a specialist -> See the chosen specialist collapse into the booking summary

features.name: Choose location and view location details
features.description: Customers can choose an on-site location for eligible services and view location information such as the address and directions.
user_flows: Navigate to /appointments/zz-schedule-preview -> Select an on-site service -> Open the location section -> Review the available location -> Open the location details to read the address -> Close the details -> Select the location -> See the chosen location collapse into the booking summary
Navigate to /appointments/zz-schedule-preview/service/online-lecture-latvian -> See that no on-site location is requested -> Continue through the booking flow without selecting a physical location

features.name: Pick a date and time
features.description: Customers can choose an available day and time from a day strip or calendar view, and move back and forth while keeping their selections.
user_flows: Navigate to /appointments/zz-schedule-preview -> Select a service, specialist, and location as needed -> Open the date and time step -> Select a day from the day strip -> Review the available times -> Select a time -> Continue to the details step

Navigate to /appointments/zz-schedule-preview -> Select a service, specialist, and location as needed -> Open the date and time step -> Toggle the calendar view -> Return to the day strip -> Select a time -> Continue to the details step

Navigate to /appointments/zz-schedule-preview -> Open the date and time step -> Select a day with no availability -> Read the no-times-available message -> Choose another day -> Select a time -> Continue to the details step
Navigate to /appointments/zz-schedule-preview -> Select a date and time -> Go back to the previous step -> Return to the booking details step with the earlier selections preserved

features.name: Enter customer details and confirm a booking
features.description: Customers provide contact details and optional notes, then confirm the booking and see a success screen with the option to book another appointment.
user_flows: Navigate to /appointments/zz-schedule-preview -> Select a service, specialist, location, date, and time -> Open the customer details step -> Submit with no details filled in -> Read the name and contact validation messages -> Fill in a name and one contact method -> Submit the booking -> See the success screen

Navigate to /appointments/zz-schedule-preview -> Select a service, specialist, location, date, and time -> Open the customer details step -> Enter a name and an invalid email address -> Submit the booking -> Read the email validation message

Navigate to /appointments/zz-schedule-preview -> Select a service, specialist, location, date, and time -> Open the customer details step -> Fill in name, valid email, optional phone, and notes -> Confirm the booking -> See the success screen -> Choose to book another appointment

features.name: Group service capacity
features.description: Group appointments remain available after one booking and show the remaining number of spots for the selected time.
user_flows: Navigate to /appointments/zz-schedule-preview/service/group-pilates-class -> Select a date and time for the group class -> Complete the booking details -> Confirm the booking -> Return to the same day and time -> See the slot still offered with a reduced remaining-spots count

features.name: Individual slot availability
features.description: For individual services, a booked time disappears from the available time list on subsequent visits so it cannot be selected again.
user_flows: Navigate to /appointments/zz-schedule-preview -> Select an individual service, specialist, location, date, and time -> Complete the booking details -> Confirm the booking -> Reopen the booking page with the same service, specialist, and day -> Verify the previously booked time is no longer available

features.name: Online delivery booking
features.description: Online services can be booked without selecting a physical location and still complete successfully.
user_flows: Navigate to /appointments/zz-schedule-preview/service/online-lecture-latvian -> See that no on-site location is required -> Select a date and time -> Enter customer details -> Confirm the booking -> See the success screen

features.name: Deep-linked booking pages
features.description: Customers can open a booking link that preselects a service, specialist, or location, and those preselected choices are locked in place.
user_flows: Navigate to /appointments/zz-schedule-preview/service/mens-haircut -> See the service row already selected and locked -> Continue through the rest of the booking flow
Navigate to /appointments/zz-schedule-preview/location/preview-studio -> See the location row already selected and locked -> Continue through the rest of the booking flow
Navigate to /appointments/zz-schedule-preview/service/does-not-exist -> See a 404 page instead of the booking wizard

features.name: Language and theme controls
features.description: Customers can switch the booking page theme and language, and their chosen language persists after a reload.
user_flows: Navigate to /appointments/zz-schedule-preview -> Open the header menu -> Switch the theme to dark -> Switch the theme back to light

Navigate to /appointments/zz-schedule-preview -> Open the header menu -> Switch the language to Azerbaijani -> Read the updated booking copy -> Reload the page -> See the chosen language still applied

features.name: Copy booking link sharing
features.description: Customers can access sharing controls and copy the booking link for reuse elsewhere.
user_flows: Navigate to /appointments/zz-schedule-preview -> Open the share menu -> Copy the booking link

features.name: Responsive booking flow
features.description: The booking wizard remains usable on a narrow mobile viewport without horizontal scrolling.
user_flows: Navigate to /appointments/zz-schedule-preview -> Resize to a mobile viewport -> Complete a booking selection flow without horizontal scrolling

features.name: Appointment cancellation
features.description: Customers can cancel an existing appointment from a signed cancellation page and confirm the action through a dialog.
user_flows: Navigate to /appointments/cancel/{appointment} using a valid signed link -> Review the appointment details -> Start the cancellation action -> Confirm the cancellation in the dialog -> See the appointment marked as cancelled

tech_stack: Vite (built assets served by php artisan serve on port 8000)

routes.description: Public booking wizard for the company "ZZ Schedule Preview". Three steps: (0) choose service / specialist / location, (1) pick date & time, (2) enter customer details and confirm. No login of any kind is required.
Deep link that opens the same wizard with the service pre-selected and locked. Other examples - /service/group-pilates-class, /service/online-lecture-latvian, /service/beard-trim.
Deep link with the specialist pre-selected and locked. Slugs are derived from specialist names (Specialist A/B/C/D, Preview Owner, Sam Idris).
Deep link with the location "Preview studio" pre-selected and locked.
Unknown deep-link slug must return a 404 page, not the wizard.

Signed-URL cancellation page reached from the confirmation email. Shows the booking, a "Cancel appointment" button and a confirm dialog. Requires a valid signature - an unsigned or tampered URL must fail.

features.name: Booking page loads with the company's services
features.description: The wizard's first step lists every active service grouped by category with price, duration and description. Active services on this company are "Beard Trim" (EUR 10, 15 min), "Children's Haircut" (EUR 15, 30 min), "Group Pilates Class" (EUR 15, 60 min, group of 10), "Men's Haircut" (EUR 20, 30 min), "Online Lecture (Latvian)" (EUR 25, 60 min, online), "Preview haircut" (EUR 30, 60 min) and "Private Pilates Lesson" (EUR 40, 60 min).
user_interactions: See the company header "ZZ Schedule Preview" and the heading "Choose your booking details"
Expand the "Service" card and read the list of services with prices and durations
Click a service card to select it; the card collapses and shows the chosen service

features.name: Choose specialist
features.description: The "Specialist" card lists the people who can perform the chosen service, with a "Next available" line. Choosing a service narrows the specialist list; choosing a specialist narrows the service list. An info button opens an "About {name}" profile dialog that can be closed again. Mapping - Men's Haircut / Children's Haircut / Beard Trim -> Specialist A or Specialist B; Preview haircut -> Preview Owner, Specialist B or Specialist C; Group Pilates Class and Private Pilates Lesson -> Specialist C; Online Lecture (Latvian) -> Specialist D.
user_interactions: Click a service, then open the "Specialist" card
Verify only specialists who offer that service are listed
Click the info icon on a specialist to open the profile dialog and close it
Select a specialist and see the card collapse to the chosen name

features.name: Choose location and view location details
features.description: On-site services are delivered at "Preview studio". The location card shows the address and opens a details dialog with a "Get directions" link. The online service ("Online Lecture (Latvian)") has no location, so the location card must not ask for one.
user_interactions: Select an on-site service and open the "Location" card
Click the location's info button to open the details dialog and read the address
Close the dialog and select "Preview studio"
Select the online service and verify no on-site location is demanded

features.name: Pick a date and time
features.description: Step two shows a horizontal strip of the next 14 days plus a month calendar toggle, then the times available on the chosen day. Times run 09:00-17:00 in the company timezone Europe/Riga. 2026-09-11 has no availability for anyone, so that day must show "No times available on this day. Try another." The "Continue" / "Choose date & time" button only advances once a time is picked.
user_interactions: Click a day chip in the day strip and read the "Choose a time" list
Toggle "Show calendar" to switch to the month view and back to the day list
Pick a day with no availability and read the empty-state message
Click a time to select it, then click the primary button to reach "Your details"
Use the "Back" button to return to the previous step and keep the selections

api_calls.endpoint: /appointments/zz-schedule-preview (Inertia partial reload of the slotWindow prop)

features.name: Enter customer details and confirm a booking
features.description: The final step collects Name, Email, Phone and optional Notes. Name is required and at least one of email or phone is required; the client shows "Please enter your name.", "Please add an email address or a phone number so we can reach you." and "Please enter a valid email address." without posting. A valid submission posts the booking and renders the success screen "You're booked in" with calendar links and "Book another appointment".
user_interactions: Click "Confirm booking" with every field empty and read the validation errors
Enter a name only, submit, and read the contact-required error
Enter an invalid email such as "not-an-email" and read the email error
Fill name plus a valid email, optionally a phone and notes, then confirm
See the success screen and click "Book another appointment" to restart the flow

features.name: Group service capacity
features.description: "Group Pilates Class" is a group service with capacity 10 at a single 60-minute slot per hour. Group slots stay bookable after a booking and show a remaining-spots badge ("{n} left"), unlike individual services whose booked slot disappears from the list.
user_interactions: Open the group class deep link and book one place at a specific time
Return to the same day and time and verify the slot is still offered with a lower remaining count

features.name: Individual slot becomes unavailable once booked
features.description: For an individual service the specialist's booked time must disappear from the times list on a second visit, so the same slot cannot be double-booked.
user_interactions: Book an individual service at a chosen time
Reopen the page with the same service, specialist and day and verify that time is gone

features.name: Online-delivery booking
features.description: "Online Lecture (Latvian)" is delivered online over Google Meet by Specialist D and has no physical location. Its flow must skip the location question and still confirm successfully.
user_interactions: Open the online service and confirm no on-site location is requested
Complete the flow and reach the success screen

features.name: Deep-linked booking pages
features.description: Service, specialist and location deep links open the wizard with that choice pinned as a locked row that cannot be changed, and a back link to the plain booking page. An unknown slug must 404.
user_interactions: Open a service deep link and verify the service row is locked to that service
Open a location deep link and verify the location row is locked
Click the back link and land on the plain booking page with nothing locked
Open an unknown slug and verify a 404 page

features.name: Language and theme controls
features.description: The header menu offers a light/dark theme switch and a language switch between English and Azerbaijani (the company's configured locales), plus a share menu with "Copy booking link". The chosen language persists across a reload through a cookie.
user_interactions: Open the header menu and switch the theme to Dark, then back to Light
Switch the language to Azerbaijani and verify the wizard copy changes
Reload the page and verify the chosen language is still applied
Open the share menu and click "Copy booking link"

features.name: Responsive booking flow
features.description: The wizard is mobile-first and must remain usable at a narrow viewport.
user_interactions: Resize to a mobile viewport and complete a selection without horizontal scrolling

known_limitations.issue: "Sam Idris" is a specialist with availability but no services attached, so selecting him leaves the service list empty.
known_limitations.impact: A visitor can reach a dead end where no service can be chosen.

known_limitations.issue: The cancellation page is only reachable through a signed URL from the confirmation email.
known_limitations.impact: It cannot be reached by clicking through the booking page alone.
